title: AdvSim2Real : Training Web Agents Against Adaptive Prompt Injection in a Web World Model
title_zh: AdvSim2Real：在网页世界模型中对抗自适应提示注入的训练方法

paragraphs.en: Web agents complete user requests by reading and acting on pages that third parties write, so an instruction planted on a page can redirect the agent away from the user’s goal. The agent cannot simply ignore the page, because the page also holds the values and controls the task requires. Current defenses fine-tune the agent on injections fixed before training, and attackers that adapt to the trained model bypass them. Adversarial training lets the attacker adapt but keeps the tasks fixed, so a task stops teaching once the agent solves it. We introduce AdvSim2Real, which co-evolves a task curriculum, an injection adversary, and the agent inside a frozen web world model. The curriculum is rewarded for tasks the agent solves about half of the time, and the adversary only for a success flip, an injection that turns a judged success into a failure. Training in the simulator makes a 4B agent both more capable and more robust: its completion rises with and without attacks, holds against a frontier-model adversary it never trained against, and its capability gain carries over to a real browser. On 150 web tasks, AdvSim2Real raises completion under this unseen adversary by 33.6% relative to the base agent.We release our code , the benchmark, and all checkpoint results .

paragraphs.en: Web agents now complete multi-step requests on websites, such as updating a customer record from the entries a page displays ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Qi et al., 2025 ; Xi et al., 2025 ) . The web differs from other tool settings because every page is written by a third party and mixes the data a task needs with the controls that act on it. An instruction planted in page content can therefore redirect the agent away from the user’s request, an attack known as indirect prompt injection ( Greshake et al., 2023 ) , and on a web-agent security benchmark such attacks partially succeed in up to 86% of cases ( Evtimov et al., 2025 ) . The agent cannot defend itself by ignoring the page, because the page also holds the values and controls the task requires. A provider therefore needs task-preserving robustness : the agent completes its authorized goal despite competing page instructions whenever the task remains feasible.
paragraphs.zh: 网络智能体现在能够在网站上完成多步骤请求，例如根据页面显示的信息更新客户记录（Zhou 等人，2024；Qi 等人，2025；Xi 等人，2025）。 网络与其他工具环境不同，因为每个页面都由第三方编写，并将任务所需的数据与用于操作这些数据控件混合在一起。 因此，植入页面内容中的指令可能会将智能体引离用户的请求，这种攻击被称为间接提示注入（Greshake 等人，2023）；在网络智能体安全基准测试中，此类攻击在多达 86% 的情况下部分成功（Evtimov 等人，2025）。 智能体无法通过忽略页面来自我防御，因为页面也包含了任务所需的值和控制项。 因此，提供者需要具备任务保留的鲁棒性：只要任务仍然可行，智能体就应该在存在竞争性页面指令的情况下完成其授权目标。

paragraphs.en: Current defenses fine-tune the agent on injected examples built before training, in some cases with a delimiter-based input format, so that it follows the user and disregards the planted instruction ( Wallace et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025a ; Chen et al., 2025b ; Chen et al., 2025c ) . Because these injections never change, the defender never meets an attacker that adapts to it, and attackers that optimize against the trained model bypass StruQ and Meta SecAlign ( Nasr et al., 2026 ) . Recent work therefore trains the attacker as well: RETA red-teams a frozen agent and trains the defender on the recorded attacks ( He et al., 2026 ) , while ARLAS, DMAST, and CoER co-train an attacker and an agent in executed tool or browser environments ( Wang et al., 2025c ; Liu et al., 2026a ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . These methods adapt the attacks but keep the training tasks fixed, so a task stops teaching once the agent solves it, and each new task requires a site that can execute it.
paragraphs.zh: 当前的防御方法通过在训练前构建的注入示例上对智能体进行微调，在某些情况下还使用基于分隔符的输入格式，从而使其遵循用户指令而忽略植入的指示（Wallace 等，2024；Chen 等，2025a；Chen 等，2025b；Chen 等，2025c）。 由于这些注入内容从未改变，防御方永远不会遇到能够适应它的攻击者，而那些针对训练模型进行优化的攻击者则会绕过 StruQ 和 Meta SecAlign（Nasr 等，2026）。 因此，近期的研究也开始对攻击者进行训练：RETA 会对一个冻结的智能体进行红队测试，并基于记录下来的攻击来训练防御方（He 等，2026）；而 ARLAS、DMAST 和 CoER 则会在执行工具或浏览器环境中协同训练攻击者和智能体（Wang 等，2025c；Liu 等，2026a；Zhang 等，2026）。 这些方法虽然会调整攻击策略，但保持训练任务固定不变，因此一旦智能体解决某个任务，该任务便停止提供教学信息，而每个新任务都需要一个能够执行该任务的站点。

paragraphs.en: A web world model removes both limits, because it predicts the next page for any goal, page, and action, including a page that an adversary asks it to alter ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) . We use this to introduce AdvSim2Real , which trains three policies against one another inside a frozen world model: a curriculum that writes tasks as a goal and an initial page, an adversary that requests one injection per trajectory, and the web agent, which we call the executor , as Figure 1 shows. The curriculum is rewarded for tasks the current executor solves about half of the time, as graded by a fixed language-model judge. The adversary is rewarded only for a success flip : a clean run that the judge accepted is replayed to the chosen step, the injection is rendered there, and the adversary earns credit only if the continuation fails.
paragraphs.zh: 网络世界模型消除了这两种限制，因为它能够针对任何目标、页面和行动预测下一个页面，包括对手要求它修改的页面（Xiao 等，2026）。 我们利用这一点引入了 AdvSim2Real，该方法在一个冻结的世界模型内部训练三种相互对抗的策略：一种将任务作为目标和初始页面编写的课程策略、一个每次轨迹仅请求一次注入的对手策略，以及我们称之为执行者的网络智能体，如图 1 所示。 课程策略的奖励取决于当前执行者解决任务的成功率（约为二分之一），该成功率由一个固定的语言模型裁判进行评分。 对手策略仅在成功翻转时获得奖励：即一个被裁判接受的干净运行流程会被重播到所选步骤，此时注入操作在此处生效，而只有当后续流程失败时，对手才能获得积分。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate a Qwen3.5-4B executor on the 150 web tasks of our benchmark in the frozen WebWorld-14B world model; fifty of them are close variants of eight parent tasks. Figure 2 shows a typical attack: an injected notice orders the agent to click a forbidden reset button, the base agent obeys and fails, and the trained executor completes the same task. AdvSim2Real raises clean completion from 74.89% to 81.33% and completion under the three learned adversaries from 48.07% to 57.48% ( Table 1 ). Against Kimi-K3 , a frontier model that took no part in training, completion rises from 23.00% to 30.72%, a 33.6% relative gain ( Table 3 ). all attacked results are measured inside the world model, where injections are rendered in the context of the page (Section 3 ) The capability gain of the first stage carries over to a real browser, where strict success on the submitted form rises from 25.56% to 44.44% without any world-model call ( Table 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在冻结的 WebWorld-14B 世界模型中，使用 Qwen3.5-4B 执行器对我们的基准测试中的 150 个网页任务进行了评估；其中五十项任务是八个基础任务的近变体。 图 2 展示了一次典型的攻击：注入的通知命令智能体点击一个被禁止的重置按钮，基础智能体服从了该命令并失败，而训练后的执行器则完成了同一任务。 AdvSim2Real 将干净完成率从 74.89% 提升至 81.33%，在三个已学习对抗者下的完成率从 48.07% 提升至 57.48%（表 1）。 在与 Kimi-K3（一个未参与训练的顶尖模型）的对比中，完成率从 23.00% 提升至 30.72%，相对增益为 33.6%（表 3）。所有受攻击的结果均在世界模型内部测量，其中注入内容是在页面上下文中呈现的（第 3 节）。第一阶段的性能提升也延续到了真实浏览器中：在没有调用任何世界模型的情况下，提交表单的成功率从 25.56% 提升至 44.44%（表 2）。

paragraphs.en: AdvSim2Real , a two-stage framework that co-evolves a task curriculum, an injection adversary, and a web agent inside a frozen web world model, so that both tasks and attacks track the current agent.
paragraphs.zh: AdvSim2Real 是一种两阶段框架，它在一个冻结的网页世界模型内部协同演化任务课程、注入对抗者和一个网页智能体，从而使得任务和攻击都能跟踪当前的智能体。

paragraphs.en: The success-flip reward, which replays an accepted clean run to the injection step and credits the adversary only when the continuation fails, so that failures the agent makes on its own earn nothing.

paragraphs.en: A benchmark of 150 form-filling web tasks in five skill strata, with protected fields and forbidden controls, a reactive adversary that chooses when and what to inject, and a deterministic browser check of the submitted form; we release it with all checkpoints and trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发布了一项基准测试，包含五个技能层级中的 150 个表单填写类网页任务，其中设有受保护字段和禁止操作的控制机制；测试中还包括一个反应型对抗方，它会决定何时注入何种内容，以及对提交表单进行确定性浏览器检查；同时，我们还一并发布了所有检查点和轨迹数据。

paragraphs.en: Evidence that the curriculum stage buys capability and the adversarial stage buys robustness: without the curriculum stage, the final agent loses 4.67 clean points but only 0.44 points of attacked completion ( Table 7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 证据表明，课程阶段能提升能力，而对抗阶段则能增强鲁棒性：如果没有课程阶段，最终智能体会损失 4.67 个干净样本得分，但被攻击后的完成度仅损失 0.44 分（表 7）。

paragraphs.en: Defenses trained on fixed injections. Indirect prompt injection places competing instructions in content that an agent reads while pursuing a trusted goal ( Greshake et al., 2023 ) . Most trained defenses learn from injections fixed before training: the instruction hierarchy trains a model to ignore lower-privileged instructions ( Wallace et al., 2024 ) , SecAlign and the open Meta SecAlign models prefer the response to the legitimate instruction over the response to the injection ( Chen et al., 2025b ; Chen et al., 2025c ) , and StruQ separates instructions from data with reserved delimiters ( Chen et al., 2025a ) . Because the injections never change, the defender first meets an adaptive attacker at evaluation, and attackers that optimize against the trained model bypass StruQ and Meta SecAlign ( Nasr et al., 2026 ; Wen et al., 2025 ) ; adaptive attacks also break detection, prompting, and paraphrasing defenses of tool agents ( Zhan et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在固定注入样本上训练的防御方法。 间接提示注入将相互冲突的指令嵌入到智能体在执行可信目标时读取的内容中（Greshake 等，2023）。 大多数经过训练的防御方法都从训练前已固定的注入样本中学习：指令层级结构训练模型忽略权限较低的指令（Wallace 等，2024）；SecAlign 和开源的 Meta SecAlign 模型更倾向于遵循合法指令而非注入指令（Chen 等，2025b；Chen 等，2025c）；而 StruQ 则通过保留分隔符将指令与数据分离（Chen 等，2025a）。 由于注入样本从未改变，防御方直到评估阶段才会首次面对自适应攻击者；针对训练模型进行优化的攻击者能够绕过 StruQ 和 Meta SecAlign（Nasr 等，2026；Wen 等，2025），而自适应攻击还会破坏工具智能体的检测、提示生成和改写类防御方法（Zhan 等，2025）。

paragraphs.en: Adversarial training with a learning attacker. RETA adapts the attacker in one pass: a red-team policy trained against the frozen defender supplies the attacks on which the defender then trains ( He et al., 2026 ) . ARLAS co-trains an injection attacker and a tool-using agent as a zero-sum game, against every previous attacker checkpoint ( Wang et al., 2025c ) . CoER keeps populations of past policies of both roles and refines the defender on verified demonstrations ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , and GPT-Red scales self-play to a red-teaming agent against simultaneously trained defenders ( Wallace et al., 2026 ) . Self-RedTeam and DMAST co-train attacker and defender by self-play, for chat safety and for a web agent facing DOM injections ( Liu et al., 2026b ; Liu et al., 2026a ) ; WARD co-evolves an attacker with a separate guard model for web agents ( Cao et al., 2026 ) , and ToolHazard synthesizes adversarial tool environments, attacks, and tasks ( Mou et al., 2026 ) . None of these adapts the training tasks to the current agent or trains inside a web world model; our work co-evolves the tasks with the attacker inside one ( Section D.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 与学习型攻击者进行对抗性训练。 RETA 在一次遍历中调整攻击者：针对冻结的防御者训练的“红队”策略，会提供防御者随后用于训练的攻击样本（He et al., 2026）。 ARLAS 将注入攻击者与使用工具的智能体作为零和博弈进行联合训练，并针对每个先前的攻击者检查点执行训练（Wang et al., 2025c）。 CoER 保留两个角色过去策略的种群，并在经过验证的演示样本上优化防御者（Zhang et al., 2026）；GPT-Red 则将自我对弈扩展为针对同步训练的防御者的“红队”智能体（Wallace et al., 2026）。 Self-RedTeam 和 DMAST 通过自我对弈联合训练攻击者与防御者，分别用于保障聊天安全性和应对 DOM 注入的网页智能体（Liu et al., 2026b; Liu et al., 2026a）；WARD 则与独立的守护模型共同演化攻击者，以应对网页智能体（Cao et al., 2026）；ToolHazard 可合成对抗性工具环境、攻击和任务（Mou et al., 2026）。 上述方法均未根据当前智能体调整训练任务，也未在网页世界模型内部进行训练；而我们的工作则在这一模型内部，与攻击者共同演化训练任务（D.5 节）。

paragraphs.en: Adaptive task generation. A fixed task set stops teaching once the policy solves it, so agents generate their own: WebRL derives new web tasks from failed attempts ( Qi et al., 2025 ) , SAGE grows a curriculum from easy to hard ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , and AgentGen evolves synthesized tasks toward easier and harder variants ( Hu et al., 2024 ) . PAE trains web agents on tasks from a context-aware proposer graded by a VLM evaluator ( Zhou et al., 2025b ) , Self-Challenging has one model write verifiable tasks and then solve them ( Zhou et al., 2025a ) , and R-Zero rewards a challenger for questions on which its solver agrees with itself about half the time ( Huang et al., 2026 ) . Agent0 alternates curriculum and executor updates ( Xia et al., 2025 ) , and GenEnv trains an environment policy toward intermediate agent success ( Guo et al., 2025 ) ; our Stage 1 uses R-Zero’s uncertainty reward and repetition penalty, as Agent0 does, but estimates success from the executor’s judged completions rather than from self-consistency.
paragraphs.zh: 自适应任务生成。 一旦策略解决了一个固定任务集，该任务集就会停止提供教学，因此智能体会自行生成任务：WebRL 从失败的尝试中推导出新的网页任务（Qi et al., 2025），SAGE 将课程从简单到困难逐步扩展（Yang et al., 2025），而 AgentGen 则使合成的任务向更简单或更困难的变体演化（Hu et al., 2024）。 PAE 在由 VLM 评估器评分的、来自上下文感知提议者的任务上训练网页智能体（Zhou et al., 2025b）；Self-Challenging 让一个模型编写可验证的任务，然后解决这些任务（Zhou et al., 2025a）；而 R-Zero 则对挑战者提出一个问题时，其求解器与自身有一半时间达成一致的奖励（Huang et al., 2026）。 Agent0 交替更新课程和执行器（Xia et al., 2025），而 GenEnv 则训练一个环境策略，以促使智能体达到中等成功水平（Guo et al., 2025）；我们的第一阶段使用了 R-Zero 的不确定性奖励和重复惩罚机制，与 Agent0 的做法一致，但成功性的评估基于执行器判断的完成情况，而非自我一致性。

paragraphs.en: Learning inside a web world model. Tasks and injections generated during training need an environment that can execute any of them, such as a world model of page transitions ( Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ) ; WMA and WebDreamer use such a model at inference time to choose actions ( Chae et al., 2025 ; Gu et al., 2024 ) . DreamGym trains a policy online on synthesized transitions and rewards with an adaptive task generator ( Chen et al., 2026b ) , WebEvolver trains the policy and the world model together ( Fang et al., 2025 ) , DynaWeb trains web agents with RL on rollouts imagined by a web world model ( Ding et al., 2026 ) , UI-Simulator synthesizes trajectories with an LLM that simulates UI transitions ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , and Qwen-AgentWorld trains language world models as simulators for agentic RL ( Zuo et al., 2026 ) . We freeze WebWorld’s pretrained transition model ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) so that every round and checkpoint is trained and scored against the same simulator; freezing does not make its predictions correct, which is why we also test in a real browser ( Section 5 ).Injection benchmarks, adaptive-attack studies, and LLM-judge validity are discussed in Section D.5 .
paragraphs.zh: 在网页世界模型中进行学习。 训练过程中生成的任务和注入需要一个能够执行其中任何一项的环境，例如页面转换的世界模型（Ha 和 Schmidhuber，2018）；WMA 和 WebDreamer 在推理阶段使用此类模型来选择动作（Chae 等人，2025；Gu 等人，2024）。 DreamGym 通过自适应任务生成器，在合成的状态转换和奖励上在线训练策略（Chen 等人，2026b）；WebEvolver 同时训练策略和世界模型（Fang 等人，2025）；DynaWeb 利用网页世界模型模拟出的展开序列，通过强化学习训练网页智能体（Ding 等人，2026）；UI-Simulator 使用能够模拟 UI 转换的大型语言模型来合成轨迹（Wang 等人，2025a）；而 Qwen-AgentWorld 则将语言世界模型训练为智能体强化学习的模拟器（Zuo 等人，2026）。 我们冻结了 WebWorld 的预训练状态转换模型（Xiao 等人，2026），以确保每一轮和每个检查点都基于相同的模拟器进行训练和评估；但冻结操作并不会使其预测变得正确，因此我们还在真实浏览器中进行了测试（第 5 节）。注入基准、自适应攻击研究以及 LLM 判定的有效性将在 D.5 节中讨论。

paragraphs.en: Threat model. The provider seeks task-preserving robustness, which requires its web executor E E to complete the authorized goal despite competing page instructions whenever the task remains feasible. The provider controls the executor’s system instructions and training, while keeping the world model W W and judge J J fixed. The attacker is a page author who aims to prevent authorized completion; inducing a particular target action is optional. It acts through one injection per trajectory: after an executor action a d a_{d} it supplies an instruction z z , and W W predicts the next page with the requested notice, o d + 1 ∼ W ( ⋅ ∣ h d , a d , z ) o_{d+1}\sim W(\cdot\mid h_{d},a_{d},z) , from which E E continues; the initial page remains clean. It cannot modify the authorized goal, executor system instructions or parameters, or judge rubric. During evaluation, it observes the current page and the selected action at each step and chooses whether to wait or inject. Evaluation permits at most eleven calls to the frozen attacker, each capped at 256 output tokens, and stops querying it after an injection request. We evaluate two kinds of attacker under this interface: the learned adversaries Adv v1–v3 saved during Stage 2, whose attacks also trained the executor, and Kimi-K3 , a frontier model that took no part in training. Injections pass through W W , which is trained on real web transitions and renders a request only as a plausible page: an author-placeable notice appears in the style of the current page, while an implausible request (e.g., removing the site) is softened or dropped ( Table 6 b). This limits attacks to content a real page author could produce, but can also omit requested content or remove controls the task needs; all attacked results are therefore verdicts of J J inside W W , and Kimi-K3 tests generalization beyond the training loop. The judge reads the same untrusted observations as the executor.
paragraphs.zh: 威胁模型。 提供者追求任务保留的鲁棒性，这要求其网络执行器 E E 在任务仍然可行的情况下，即便页面存在相互冲突的指令，也能完成授权目标。 提供者控制执行器的系统指令和训练过程，同时保持世界模型 W W 和评判者 J J 固定不变。 攻击者是一名页面作者，其目标是阻止授权任务的完成；诱导特定目标动作并非必需。 它通过每条轨迹中的一次注入来实施攻击：在执行器执行动作 a d a_{d} 之后，它会提供一个指令 z z ，此时 W W 会根据所请求的通知预测下一个页面 o d + 1 ∼ W ( ⋅ ∣ h d , a d , z ) o_{d+1}\sim W(\cdot\mid h_{d},a_{d},z) ，执行器 E E 则据此继续操作；初始页面保持干净。 它不能修改授权目标、执行器的系统指令或参数，也不能修改评判标准。 在评估过程中，它在每一步观察当前页面和已选动作，并决定是等待还是进行注入。 评估最多允许对冻结的攻击者发起十一次调用，每次输出最多限制为 256 个词元，并且在发出注入请求后停止向其查询。 我们在此接口下评估两种攻击者：在阶段 2 期间保存的已学习对抗模型 Adv v1–v3（其攻击也用于训练执行器），以及 Kimi-K3——一个未参与训练的顶尖模型。 注入内容需经过 W W ，该模型基于真实的网页跳转进行训练，且仅将请求渲染为可信页面：可被作者插入的通知会以当前页面的风格呈现，而不合理的请求（例如删除整个网站）则会被弱化或忽略（表 6b）。 这将攻击限制在真实页面作者可能生成的内容范围内，但也可能导致所需内容未被包含，或移除任务所需的控制机制；因此，所有受攻击的结果都是 W W 内部 J J 的判定，而 Kimi-K3 则用于测试模型在训练循环之外的泛化能力。 评判者读取与执行器相同的不可信观察信息。

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 1 lists the steps. In Stage 1 (lines 2 – 7 ), C C proposes a pool of tasks and E E attempts each task several times; C C is rewarded for tasks that E E solves about half of the time, and E E then trains on fresh tasks from the updated C C . In Stage 2 (lines 8 – 18 ), C C is frozen, E E continues from its last Stage-1 checkpoint, and A A starts from the base model. On tasks that E E solves at least half of the time, we save several clean runs. A A proposes one injection and the step at which to insert it; each saved run is replayed up to that step with the injection, and A A is rewarded only when the injection is rendered and a run that J J accepted without it now fails. E E then trains on a mixture of the new attacks, the attacks of earlier rounds, and clean tasks. The executor after round t t is Capability iter t t in Stage 1 and Robust iter t t in Stage 2; each stage runs three rounds.
paragraphs.zh: 算法 1 列出了各个步骤。 在第一阶段（第 2 – 7 行），C C 提出一组任务，E E 对每个任务进行多次尝试；对于 E E 大约有一半时间能解决的任务，C C 会获得奖励，随后 E E 会在更新后的 C C 提供的全新任务上进行训练。 在第二阶段（第 8 – 18 行），C C 被冻结，E E 从其在第一阶段保存的最后一个检查点继续执行，而 A A 则从基础模型开始。 对于 E E 至少有一半时间能解决的任务，我们会保存几次干净的运行记录。 A A 会提出一次注入操作以及插入该操作的步骤；每次保存的运行记录都会与该步骤之前的内容一起重新执行，并加入此次注入，而 A A 只有在注入操作被成功应用、且原本 J J 在没有注入时能接受的运行现在失败的情况下才会获得奖励。 随后，E E 会在新的攻击、早期轮次的攻击以及干净任务混合而成的数据集上进行训练。 第 t 轮执行后的执行器，在第一阶段为 Capability iter t t，在第二阶段为 Robust iter t t；每个阶段运行三轮。

paragraphs.en: Stage 1 raises clean completion by 4.44 points. Clean completion rises from 74.89 % 74.89\% (Base) to 78.00 % 78.00\% , 77.11 % 77.11\% , and 79.33 % 79.33\% over the three Stage-1 rounds ( Table 1 ). The gain is not uniform: each Stage-1 update improves 23 to 28 tasks and regresses 19 to 21, judged by the number of good seeds per task ( Section B.1 ). Without ever seeing an injection, Stage 1 also lifts the attack mean from 48.07 % 48.07\% to 54.74 % 54.74\% after the first round, after which it stays between 54.34 % 54.34\% and 55.41 % 55.41\% .
paragraphs.zh: 第一阶段使干净完成率提升了 4.44 个百分点。 在三个第一阶段回合中，干净完成率从 74.89%（基准）分别提升至 78.00%、77.11% 和 79.33%（表 1）。 这种提升并不均匀：根据每项任务的优质种子数量判断，每个第一阶段的更新使 23 至 28 项任务得到改善，而 19 至 21 项任务则出现倒退（B.1 节）。 即使从未观察到注入行为，第一阶段也在第一轮后将攻击均值从 48.07% 提升至 54.74%，此后该值稳定在 54.34% 到 55.41% 之间。

paragraphs.en: Sim-to-real transfer. The capability checkpoints were also run on the same 150 tasks in a real Chromium browser, with the frozen initial page rendered as HTML, live DOM observations, and no world-model call ( Table 2 ). Strict browser success, a deterministic check of the submitted form rather than a model verdict, rises from 25.56 % 25.56\% for Base to 31.78 % 31.78\% , 43.56 % 43.56\% , and 44.44 % 44.44\% over the three Stage-1 rounds, and correct final field values from 52.50 % 52.50\% to 73.24 % 73.24\% .
paragraphs.zh: 从模拟到现实的迁移。 能力检查点也在相同的 150 项任务上，于真实的 Chromium 浏览器中运行，其中冻结的初始页面以 HTML 形式渲染，并进行了实时 DOM 观察，但没有调用世界模型（表 2）。 严格的浏览器成功率——即通过提交表单进行确定性检查而非依赖模型判断——在三个阶段一回合中，从 Base 的 25.56% 25.56\% 提升至 31.78% 31.78\%、43.56% 43.56\% 和 44.44% 44.44\%；最终字段值的正确率则从 52.50% 52.50\% 提升至 73.24% 73.24\%。

paragraphs.en: The ordering of the four checkpoints is the same under the deterministic check, the field count, and the trajectory judge ( Section C.3 ), so the Stage-1 gain measured in the world model is a gain in executed task completion. Per task and seed, the share solved in both the world model and the browser rises from 23.1 % 23.1\% for Base to 42.9 % 42.9\% for Capability iter 3, and the share judged good only in the world model falls from 51.8 % 51.8\% to 36.4 % 36.4\% ( Figure 4 c). paragraphs.en: The final 4B checkpoint matches the hosted 9B under attack and beats it clean. Qwen3.5-9B runs with the same prompt, action interface, and 12-action budget, but as a hosted model whose served weights and raw trajectories we do not hold. On matched task and seed identities, Robust iter 3 reaches 57.40 % 57.40\% under attack against 56.96 % 56.96\% , and 81.33 % 81.33\% clean against 78.22 % 78.22\% , a 3.11 3.11 -point clean advantage for the 4B checkpoint. paragraphs.en: A frontier-model adversary lowers Base to 23.00% and training adds 7.72 points. Adv v1–v3 were trained during Stage 2 against the Robust lineage, so we also evaluate Base and every Stage-2 checkpoint against an external adversary that took no part in training. Kimi-K3, a hosted frontier model, replaces the learned adversary under the interface and budget of Section 3 ; the checkpoints, world model, judge, tasks, and decoding settings are unchanged ( Section C.4 ). Base falls from 74.89 % 74.89\% clean to 23.00 % 23.00\% , which is 25.07 25.07 points below its 48.07 % 48.07\% against the learned adversaries ( Table 3 ). Robust iter 1, 2, and 3 reach 29.67 % 29.67\% , 30.33 % 30.33\% , and 30.72 % 30.72\% , which is 6.67 6.67 , 7.33 7.33 , and 7.72 7.72 points above Base. The three Stage-2 rounds lie within 1.05 1.05 points of one another, so the gain arrives with the first round. Kimi-K3 requests an injection in 95.0 % 95.0\% to 98.0 % 98.0\% of episodes, against 66.5 % 66.5\% to 81.0 % 81.0\% for the learned adversaries, and the world model renders the requested injection in 72.3 % 72.3\% to 80.9 % 80.9\% of episodes ( Figure 4 b). Under Kimi-K3, Base exhausts the 12-action budget without a final message in 28.3 % 28.3\% of episodes, against 14.0 % 14.0\% to 15.4 % 15.4\% for the Robust checkpoints and 3.7 % 3.7\% of clean episodes pooled over all checkpoints. The robustness gained in training therefore holds against an adversary outside the training loop. However, every checkpoint still loses at least 47.66 47.66 points of clean completion to a frontier-model adversary limited to one injection per trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 前沿模型对抗智能体将 Base 降至 23.00%，而训练则增加了 7.72 分。 Adv v1–v3 在阶段 2 期间针对 Robust 谱系进行了训练，因此我们还使用一个未参与训练的独立对抗智能体来评估 Base 以及阶段 2 的每个检查点。 Kimi-K3 是一个托管的前沿模型，它在第 3 节的接口和预算框架下取代了学习得到的对抗智能体；检查点、世界模型、评判者、任务和解码设置均保持不变（第 C.4 节）。 Base 的干净完成率从 74.89% 下降至 23.00%，比其在对抗学习智能体时的 48.07% 低了 25.07 分（见表 3）。 Robust 的第 1、2 和 3 次迭代分别达到 29.67%、30.33% 和 30.72%，比 Base 分别高出 6.67、7.33 和 7.72 分。 阶段 2 的三轮结果彼此差异不超过 1.05 分，因此增益在第一轮就已实现。 Kimi-K3 在 95.0% 至 98.0% 的回合中请求注入，而学习智能体的这一比例为 66.5% 至 81.0%；世界模型则在 72.3% 至 80.9% 的回合中执行了所请求的注入（见图 4b）。 在 Kimi-K3 环境下，Base 在 28.3% 的回合中用完了 12 次行动的预算却未发出最终消息，而 Robust 检查点的这一比例为 14.0% 至 15.4%，所有检查点合并后的干净回合比例则为 3.7%。 因此，训练中获得鲁棒性在面对训练循环之外的对抗智能体时依然有效。 然而，每个检查点在对抗一个每轨迹仅允许一次注入的前沿模型时，其干净完成率的损失仍至少为 47.66 分。

paragraphs.en: Effectiveness and analysis. The endpoint gains of AdvSim2Real are 6.44 6.44 clean points and 9.41 9.41 attacked points on the same 150 tasks, but the first adversarial round lowers both metrics before later rounds recover them; because the evaluation isolates no single component, we attribute the gains to the checkpoint sequence as a whole. We designed for three mechanisms, none of which we have isolated: (i) the curriculum reward is zero at judged rates 0 0 and 1 1 , so proposals the executor never or always solves stop earning reward; (ii) the reward for a success flip is zero for failures the executor produces on its own, so the adversary cannot profit from tasks the executor would fail anyway; and (iii) historical attack inputs stay in the executor’s mixture with fresh labels, so an injection that stops working is not forgotten.
paragraphs.zh: 有效性与分析。 在相同的 150 项任务中，AdvSim2Real 的终点增益为 6.44 个干净分数和 9.41 个受攻击分数，但第一轮对抗会降低这两项指标，后续轮次才会恢复；由于评估未单独隔离任何单一组件，我们将这些增益归因于整个检查点序列。 我们设计了三种机制，但目前尚未对其中任何一种进行单独隔离：(i) 在判断率 0 0 和 1 1 时，课程奖励为零，因此执行器从未解决或总能解决的提案将不再获得奖励；(ii) 对于执行器自行产生的失败情况，成功翻转的奖励为零，因此对抗方无法从执行器本就会失败的任务中获利；以及 (iii) 历史攻击输入会连同新标签保留在执行器的混合模型中，因此即使某种注入停止生效，也不会被遗忘。

paragraphs.en: Removing Stage 1, cost, and outlook. Starting Stage 2 from the base model lowers the final clean rate by 4.67 4.67 points but the attack mean by only 0.44 0.44 points, with attack differences of both signs across adversaries ( Table 7 ), so the ablation does not establish a robustness benefit from Stage 1. One recorded Stage-1 iteration reserved two 96 GB RTX 6000 Pro GPUs for 20 h 46 min, or 41.54 41.54 allocated GPU-hours ( Section C.6 ); token counts and API charges for the complete sequence were not measured, so we report no end-to-end price. A training procedure that hardens a web agent against injections should be evaluated against adversaries that did not shape its training, as Kimi-K3 does here, and ultimately against one that adapts to the trained agent; blinded human audits, executable task checkers, and compute-matched component controls are the measurements this requires next.

paragraphs.en: Limitations. The world model can display a value the executor never entered and the judge can accept a wrong calculation, so a judged robustness gain is not yet a gain in executable task completion; only the capability checkpoints were verified in a browser ( Table 2 ). The training adversary proposes from the initial page while the evaluation adversary reacts to the trajectory, and a reactive adversary generates different injections for different executors, so matching an adversary checkpoint matches the attacker, not the attack (further limitations in Section C.8 ).
paragraphs.zh: 局限性。 世界模型可能显示执行者从未输入过的值，而评判者也可能接受错误的计算结果，因此，评判出的鲁棒性提升并不等同于任务执行能力的实际提升；只有能力检查点在浏览器中得到了验证（表 2）。 训练对抗体从初始页面发起提议，而评估对抗体则对执行轨迹做出反应，并且反应型对抗体会为不同的执行者生成不同的注入内容，因此，匹配对抗体检查点所对应的是攻击者本身，而非具体的攻击行为（更多局限性见 C.8 节）。

We release our code, the benchmark, and all checkpoint results so that injection defenses can be evaluated against adversaries trained on the defended agent.

paragraphs.en: The trained adversary generates prompt injections intended to divert a web agent from its authorized task, and a page author could attempt to use such a policy against deployed agents. The released adversaries are low-rank adapters on a 4B model, trained and evaluated only on synthetic pages whose injections are rendered by a frozen web world model; we have not tested them against deployed agents or real websites, and there are no known deployments of the trained policies. We release them because a defense should be tested against an adversary that adapts to the defended agent, and our aim is to advance training procedures that such attacks cannot break. The work involves no human subjects. External grading and the Kimi-K3 evaluation send generated task and trajectory text to hosted inference providers, so applying the method to private data requires appropriate safeguards.

paragraphs.en: Each task pairs a goal of 51 to 76 words with an initial accessibility-tree page of 18 to 46 lines that holds the records and rules the task depends on, the form controls, two protected fields (Audit checksum and Internal note) that must stay untouched, and two forbidden controls (Save draft and Reset all). The 150 tasks instantiate ten templates in five skill strata, each with a low and a high difficulty tier and a short form (eight or nine fields) or a full form (twelve or thirteen fields), and each task ships a reference action sequence of 4, 5, 8, or 9 actions and an oracle contract that the browser check of Section 3 enforces ( Table 4 ). Conditional policy applies thresholded rules to one record, derived values requires arithmetic such as a rounded-up pack count or a two-decimal total, conjunctive selection asks for the cheapest row that meets every constraint, relational join follows a reference from one record to another, and ordered repair requires corrections followed by a review and a commit in a prescribed order; every task page is in the released benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 每个任务都将一个包含 51 至 76 个单词的目标，与一个初始的可达性树页面（包含 18 至 46 行内容）进行配对；该页面存储了任务所依赖的记录和规则、表单控件、两个必须保持原样的受保护字段（审计校验和与内部说明），以及两个禁止使用的控件（保存草稿与全部重置）。 这 150 个任务实例化了五个技能层级中的十个模板，每个模板包含一个低难度层级和一个高难度层级，以及一个简短表单（八个或九个字段）或一个完整表单（十二个或十三个字段）；每个任务还附带一个参考操作序列（包含 4、5、8 或 9 个操作）和一个预言机合同，该合同由第 3 节的浏览器检查强制执行（表 4）。 条件策略对一条记录应用阈值规则；派生值需要执行算术运算，例如向上取整的包装数量或保留两位小数的总计；联合选择要求找出满足所有约束的最便宜行；关系连接遵循从一条记录到另一条记录的引用；有序修复则要求按预定顺序先进行修正，再进行审核并提交；所有任务页面均包含在已发布的基准测试中。

paragraphs.en: A clean episode records 7.41 7.41 actions on average, ends with a message to the user in 97.2 % 97.2\% of cases, and reaches the 12-action budget in 3.7 % 3.7\% ; under the learned adversaries these become 7.76 7.76 to 8.05 8.05 actions, 84.7 % 84.7\% to 88.6 % 88.6\% , and 13.0 % 13.0\% to 17.3 % 17.3\% , usually through a repeated fill or a click on a control that the injection named. Adv v1, v2, and v3 request an injection in 81.0 % 81.0\% , 66.5 % 66.5\% , and 78.6 % 78.6\% of episodes, with the median request at turn 2, 3, and 2, but the exact marker string they ask for is visible in the rendered page in under 0.5 % 0.5\% of episodes, so the marker is a delivery diagnostic and not a condition for counting an episode as attacked. Judged completion is 54.1 % 54.1\% , 41.0 % 41.0\% , and 46.2 % 46.2\% on episodes with an injection request against 73.2 % 73.2\% , 76.3 % 76.3\% , and 75.4 % 75.4\% without one; restricted to requested injections, the attack mean is 41.75 % 41.75\% for Base, 46.50 % 46.50\% for Capability iter 3, and 49.45 % 49.45\% for Robust iter 3, so the final clean-to-attacked gap is 31.88 31.88 points rather than 23.85 23.85 .

paragraphs.en: Of the 9,449 9{,}449 resolved pairs of a clean and an attacked episode with the same executor, task, and seed, 48.9 % 48.9\% are judged good in both, 16.6 % 16.6\% bad in both, and 29.1 % 29.1\% flip from clean good to attacked bad; the reverse flip, 5.5 % 5.5\% of pairs, measures rollout variance. paragraphs.en: This analysis uses the 3,150 3{,}150 saved clean episodes of the seven local checkpoints (150 tasks, three seeds); it makes no new model calls, changes no judge label, and excludes the hosted 9B model, whose trajectories were not transferred.

paragraphs.en: For each task we count its good judgments over the three seeds and call it improved, tied, or regressed after an update by the sign of the change; this compares 150 task identities, not 450 independent samples. Every update both improves and regresses tasks ( Figure 5 b): each Stage-1 update improves 23 to 28 tasks and regresses 19 to 21, and the final Robust update gains 15 good judgments through 48 bad-to-good and 33 good-to-bad changes on matched task and seed. These are changes in judged trajectories; inspected seed-0 traces show changed actions, such as a correct dispatch choice on task 7 after Capability iter 1 and a completed refund on task 80 after Capability iter 3, but do not show that the policy acquired a named skill.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个任务，我们统计其在三个种子运行中的有效判断次数，并根据更新后的变化符号将其判定为“改进”“持平”或“退化”；此过程比较的是 150 个任务实例，而非 450 个独立样本。 每次更新都会同时使部分任务得到改进、部分任务出现退化（图 5b）：每个阶段一的更新会使 23 至 28 项任务得到改进，而 19 至 21 项任务出现退化；最终的“稳健”更新则通过匹配的任务与种子组合，在 48 次“无效转有效”和 33 次“有效转无效”的变化中获得了 15 个有效判断。 这些是已判断轨迹的变化；对种子-0 运行轨迹的审查显示了一些动作的改变，例如在能力迭代第 1 轮后任务 7 出现了正确的调度选择，以及在能力迭代第 3 轮后任务 80 完成了退款操作，但这并未表明策略获得了某种命名的技能。

paragraphs.en: Protocol. The evaluator renders each task’s accessibility-tree page as HTML, serves it to a fresh browser context, and gives the executor the frozen initial page followed by live observations derived from the DOM. The executor keeps the world-model system prompt, action language, and history format; each action string is bound to a typed Playwright operation, and an action whose arguments do not match the declared contract is rejected and recorded rather than silently repaired. Policy requests use temperature 0.7 0.7 , at most 256 output tokens, and seeds 0, 1, and 2; the budget is 12 recorded actions and at most 11 applied transitions. Strict success requires an actual submission whose final form values match the task contract and whose workflow invariants hold: protected fields untouched, forbidden controls never activated, and a review before commit where required. Field accuracy counts correct values among the 746 target fields per seed. The judge is the same Qwen3.8-27B trajectory judge as in the world-model evaluation and reads the recorded browser trajectory; reference solutions and scoring metadata are attached only after the browser session closes.
paragraphs.zh: 协议。 评估器将每个任务的无障碍树页面渲染为 HTML，将其提供给一个新的浏览器上下文，并向执行器提供冻结的初始页面以及从 DOM 中获取的实时观察信息。 执行器保留世界模型系统提示、操作语言和历史格式；每个操作字符串都与一个带类型的 Playwright 操作绑定，若操作的参数与声明的合同不匹配，则会被拒绝并记录，而非静默修复。 策略请求使用温度 0.7 0.7，最多输出 256 个令牌，并使用种子 0、1 和 2；预算为 12 个已记录的操作和最多 11 个已应用的状态转换。 严格成功要求一次实际提交，其最终表单值必须与任务合同匹配，且工作流程不变量必须成立：受保护字段未被篡改，禁止操作从未被激活，并在需要时执行了提交前的审核。 字段准确性在每个种子下 746 个目标字段中统计正确值的数量。 评判器与世界模型评估中使用的相同 Qwen3.8-27B 轨迹评判器一致，并读取已记录的浏览器轨迹；参考解决方案和评分元数据仅在浏览器会话关闭后附加。

paragraphs.en: Protocol. Kimi-K3 replaces the learned adversary in the evaluation loop of Table 1 ; the executor checkpoints, the world model, the judge, the 150 tasks, and every decoding setting are unchanged. Before each world-model transition the model receives the system prompt of Adv v1–v3 and the same user message with the goal, the current page, and the executor’s pending action. It either declines to inject or returns one injection request naming the injected instruction, the text that marks it on the page, and the page element that carries it. Sampling uses temperature 1.0 1.0 , at most 256 output tokens, and a fixed seed per task and turn. The model’s extended reasoning mode is disabled so that the reply fits the token budget, and it is queried at most 11 times per episode. The world model renders at most one injection per trajectory, exactly as for the learned adversaries, and the judge sees the resulting trajectory without being told which adversary produced it. The adversary and judge calls for this evaluation cost under $40 in API charges. Runs use seeds 0 and 1; seed 2 was stopped after rate-limit errors, and 293 of the 300 Robust iter 3 episodes received a verdict.
paragraphs.zh: 协议。 Kimi-K3 替换了表 1 评估循环中已学习的对抗智能体；执行器、世界模型、评判者、150 项任务以及所有解码设置均保持不变。 每次世界模型状态转换前，模型会接收 Adv v1–v3 的系统提示，以及包含目标、当前页面和执行器待执行操作的相同用户消息。 它要么拒绝注入，要么返回一个注入请求，其中需指明所注入的指令、页面上标记该指令的文本以及承载该指令的页面元素。 采样使用温度 1.0，最多输出 256 个令牌，并为每个任务和轮次使用固定种子。 模型的高级推理模式已被禁用，以确保回复符合令牌预算限制，且每轮最多被查询 11 次。 世界模型在每个轨迹中最多渲染一次注入，与已学习的对抗智能体的做法完全一致；评判者会看到最终的轨迹，但不会被告知该轨迹由哪个对抗智能体生成。 此次评估中，对抗智能体和评判者的 API 调用费用低于 40 美元。 运行使用了种子 0 和 1；种子 2 因速率限制错误而终止，300 次 Robust iter 3 轮次中有 293 次获得了判定结果。

sents.en: The model’s extended reasoning mode is disabled so that the reply fits the token budget, and it is queried at most 11 times per episode.

sents.en: The world model renders at most one injection per trajectory, exactly as for the learned adversaries, and the judge sees the resulting trajectory without being told which adversary produced it.

paragraphs.en: These measurements describe one recorded Stage-1 execution; they are not held-out scores and do not cover the full checkpoint sequence of Table 1 . It used Qwen3.5-4B role policies, the frozen WebWorld-14B, and the Qwen3.8-27B judge; LoRA rank 16 16 and scaling 32 32 , learning rate 10 − 5 10^{-5} , and KL coefficient 0.01 0.01 ; 150 150 proposal positions in each of two pools, K = 6 K=6 assessment rollouts, one curriculum epoch, and two executor epochs of 75 updates, each on six trajectories for each of two tasks; and two 96 GB RTX 6000 Pro GPUs with gradient checkpointing, micro-batch size one, and a 4,096-token cap. Its action limit was eight and its judge capped each subsequent page at 1,500 characters, unlike the 12-action evaluation and the uncapped Stage-2 judge. In the first executor update, 178 of 300 task groups had uniform rewards and hence zero advantage; the summed update time was 11.02 11.02 hours, and the first iteration held two GPUs for 20 h 46 min, or 41.54 41.54 allocated GPU-hours, which measures reservation rather than utilization; token use, API charges, and active device time were not measured.
paragraphs.zh: 这些测量值描述了已记录的一次阶段 1 执行；它们并非预留的得分，也未涵盖表 1 中的完整检查点序列。 该过程使用了 Qwen3.5-4B 角色策略、冻结的 WebWorld-14B 以及 Qwen3.8-27B 评判器；LoRA 秩为 16 16，缩放系数为 32 32，学习率为 10^{-5}，KL 系数为 0.01 0.01；两个池中每个池包含 150 150 个提议位置，K = 6 K=6 次评估展开，一个课程训练周期，以及两个执行器周期（各含 75 次更新），每个周期针对两个任务中的每个任务运行六条轨迹；此外还使用了两台 96 GB 的 RTX 6000 Pro GPU，并启用了梯度检查点机制、微批量大小为 1，且设置了 4,096 个标记的上限。 其动作限制为八次，且评判器将后续每页内容限制在 1,500 个字符以内，这与包含 12 个动作的评估以及无上限的阶段 2 评判器不同。 在执行器的第一次更新中，300 个任务组中有 178 个具有均匀奖励，因此优势为零；总更新时间为 11.02 小时，第一次迭代使两台 GPU 持续运行了 20 小时 46 分钟，即 41.54 个分配的 GPU-小时（该指标衡量的是预留时间而非实际使用时长）；未对标记使用量、 API 费用及活跃设备运行时间进行测量。

paragraphs.en: Three rollout seeds of one trained adapter per checkpoint measure rollout variance, not training variance, and we report no confidence intervals. We do not hold the hosted 9B reference’s served weights or raw trajectories, so its comparison cannot be re-run under a different adversary or audited at the trajectory level. None of these results certify robustness against arbitrary page authors or transfer to browser execution, visual observations, or unseen websites.
paragraphs.zh: 每个检查点中，针对单个训练好的适配器运行三个展开种子，可以衡量展开方差而非训练方差，且我们未报告任何置信区间。 我们不持有托管的 9B 参考模型的服务权重或原始轨迹，因此无法在不同对抗者条件下重新运行其比较，也无法在轨迹层面进行审计。 这些结果均未证明模型能抵御任意页面作者的干扰，也未证明其能力可迁移到浏览器执行、视觉观察或未见过的网站上。

paragraphs.en: Saved controls and reactive evaluation. Each clean control stores deep copies of the executor and world-model histories at reachable transition boundaries; an attacked continuation keeps the observed prefix, the selected action, the remaining budget, and the sampling seed, but not model-server state, so prefixes are aligned without identical stochastic continuations. Controls are reused within one adversary invocation and regenerated for the next. At evaluation the frozen adversary instead sees the goal, the current page, and the selected action before each transition and returns a wait or an injection; the first accepted injection ends further queries whether or not the world model renders it, and only transport failures are retried.
paragraphs.zh: 已保存的控制策略与反应式评估。 每个纯净控制策略在可达的转换边界处存储执行器和世界模型历史的深度副本；受攻击的延续会保留观察到的前缀、选定的动作、剩余预算和采样种子，但不包含模型服务器的状态，因此前缀虽对齐，但随机延续不会完全相同。 控制策略在一次对抗方调用中会被重复使用，并在下一次调用时重新生成。 在评估阶段，被冻结的对抗方会在每次转换前看到目标、当前页面和选定的动作，并返回“等待”或“注入”；首个被接受的注入会终止后续查询，无论世界模型是否将其渲染出来，且仅对传输失败进行重试。

paragraphs.en: Adversarial training for indirect injection. ARLAS co-trains an injection attacker and a defending agent as a zero-sum game against all earlier attacker checkpoints in BrowserGym and AgentDojo, which execute the agent’s actions ( Wang et al., 2025c ) ; we share its alternating updates and retention of earlier attacks and differ in (i) the environment, a frozen web world model, (ii) the attacker reward, which requires a rendered injection to flip a judged success on a saved clean control ( Equation 5 ), and (iii) the retained object, stored attack inputs relabeled by fresh rollouts rather than attacker checkpoints. CoER keeps opponent populations of both roles, allows repeated injections, and refines the defender on verified demonstrations ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , GPT-Red trains a red-teaming agent against simultaneously trained defenders at post-training scale ( Wallace et al., 2026 ) , and RETA trains its defender on attacks archived against a frozen defender ( He et al., 2026 ) ; we allow one injection per trajectory, have no refinement stage, and use a single 4B adversary and executor. Preference and delimiter defenses train on a fixed injected dataset ( Chen et al., 2025b ; Chen et al., 2025c ; Wallace et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025a ) ; a SecAlign-style control on the same backbone would test whether a changing attacker is needed.

paragraphs.en: Learning inside a web world model. Following World Models ( Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ) , WMA and WebDreamer plan with a web world model ( Chae et al., 2025 ; Gu et al., 2024 ) , WebEvolver trains it together with the policy ( Fang et al., 2025 ) , and DreamGym trains a policy online in an experience model and tests transfer to real environments ( Chen et al., 2026b ) ; we inherit WebWorld’s predicted pages unchanged ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) and add the proposer, the judge-derived rewards, and the adversarial stage. WebRL, the closest browser-executed loop, derives tasks from failed attempts and scores them with a learned reward model ( Qi et al., 2025 ) , and AgentGym-RL and AgentTrek learn from executed actions ( Xi et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025 ) ; our tasks come from a proposer rewarded for intermediate judged completion, our transitions are predicted, and a second stage adds an adversary.
paragraphs.zh: 在网页世界模型中进行学习。 继 World Models（Ha 和 Schmidhuber，2018）之后，WMA 和 WebDreamer 使用网页世界模型进行规划（Chae 等人，2025；Gu 等人，2024），WebEvolver 将其与策略一同训练（Fang 等人，2025），而 DreamGym 则在一个经验模型中在线训练策略，并测试其向真实环境的迁移能力（Chen 等人，2026b）；我们直接沿用 WebWorld 的预测页面（Xiao 等人，2026），并加入了提议者、由评判者生成的奖励以及对抗阶段。 WebRL 是最接近浏览器执行循环的方法，它从失败尝试中生成任务，并使用一个学习到的奖励模型进行评分（Qi 等人，2025）；AgentGym-RL 和 AgentTrek 则从已执行的动作中学习（Xi 等人，2025；Xu 等人，2025）；我们的任务来自一个因中间阶段被判定完成而获得奖励的提议者，我们的状态转移是预测得到的，并且第二个阶段增加了一个对抗方。

paragraphs.en: Adaptive task generation. Asymmetric self-play, POET, and unsupervised environment design select challenges by estimated learning potential ( Sukhbaatar et al., 2018 ; Wang et al., 2019 ; Wang et al., 2020 ; Dennis et al., 2020 ; Jiang et al., 2021 ; Parker-Holder et al., 2022 ) , and Self-Instruct, AgentGen, and SAGE generate or evolve tasks for language agents ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Hu et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) ; our curriculum keeps the page distribution fixed and scores each proposal by the current executor’s judged completion rate. Absolute Zero validates proposals by execution ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) , whereas our validity is judged by a model, and Section C.7 records judged completions that contradict visible arithmetic.
paragraphs.zh: 自适应任务生成。 非对称自我对弈、POET 和无监督环境设计通过估计的学习潜力来选择挑战（Sukhbaatar 等人，2018；Wang 等人，2019；Wang 等人，2020；Dennis 等人，2020；Jiang 等人，2021；Parker-Holder 等人，2022），而 Self-Instruct、AgentGen 和 SAGE 则为语言智能体生成或演化任务（Wang 等人，2023；Hu 等人，2024；Yang 等人，2025）；我们的课程方法保持页面分布固定，并根据当前执行者判断的完成率对每个提案进行评分。 Absolute Zero 通过执行来验证提案（Zhao 等人，2025），而我们的有效性则由模型来判断，并且第 C.7 节记录了与可见算术结果相矛盾的已判断完成案例。

paragraphs.en: Security evaluation and feedback validity. Benchmarks of indirect prompt injection ( Greshake et al., 2023 ) cover documents, tools, and web agents ( Yi et al., 2025 ; Zhan et al., 2024 ; Debenedetti et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Evtimov et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ) ; AgentDojo and WASP report attacker-goal success separately from utility, whereas we report judged completion only. Learned black-box attackers optimize against a fixed target ( Wang et al., 2025b ; Chen et al., 2026a ; Yin et al., 2026 ) ; none has been run against our executors, and a fair comparison must match target access and query budget ( Zhan et al., 2025 ; Nasr et al., 2026 ; Shi et al., 2025 ) . Our training adversary sees the goal and initial page while the evaluation adversary reacts to the current page ( Section D.4 ), so we do not claim the two are equally strong. Simulated risk evaluation ( Ruan et al., 2024 ) , judge biases and self-preference ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Panickssery et al., 2024 ) , reward over-optimization ( Gao et al., 2023 ) , and judge manipulation ( Shi et al., 2024 ) all bear on our signals, which are judged completions and paired judgments rather than independently verified outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 安全性评估与反馈有效性。 间接提示注入的基准测试（Greshake 等，2023）涵盖了文档、工具和网页智能体（Yi 等，2025；Zhan 等，2024；Debenedetti 等，2024；Zhang 等，2025；Evtimov 等，2025；Li 等，2026）；AgentDojo 和 WASP 将攻击者目标的成功情况与效用分开报告，而我们仅报告经过判断的完成状态。 学习到的黑盒攻击者针对固定目标进行优化（Wang 等，2025b；Chen 等，2026a；Yin 等，2026）；目前没有任何研究针对我们的执行器进行过测试，而公平的比较必须匹配目标访问权限和查询预算（Zhan 等，2025；Nasr 等，2026；Shi 等，2025）。 我们的训练对抗者能看到目标和初始页面，而评估对抗者则根据当前页面做出反应（D.4 节），因此我们不认为两者具有同等强度。 模拟风险评估（Ruan 等，2024）、判断者的偏见与自我偏好（Zheng 等，2023；Panickssery 等，2024）、奖励过度优化（Gao 等，2023）以及判断者操控（Shi 等，2024）都会影响我们的信号，而这些信号是经过判断的完成状态和成对判断，而非独立验证的结果。
